blocks.title: Variable
blocks.text: Variable computer ki memory mein aisa dabba hai jo data rakhta hai jise program mein baad mein nikala aur badla ja sakta hai. Program chalte waqt is ki qeemat badal sakti hai, isi liye ise variable kehte hain.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
age = 71
print("Quaid-i-Azam lived for", age, "years")
age = 60
print("Allama Iqbal lived for", age, "years")

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is code se pehle ek line print ( age ="As - Salaam-Alaikum , dear students ! ") chhapti hai. Python mein yeh chalegi nahi: print() ko age naam ka keyword argument nahi diya ja sakta, to TypeError aata hai. Salaam dikhana ho to print("As-Salaam-Alaikum, dear students!") likhein. Is liye lesson mein yeh line nahi rakhi gayi; baqi code kitab wala hi hai.
Yahan variable age ko mukhtalif qeematein di gayi hain ta ke Quaid-i-Azam Muhammad Ali Jinnah aur Allama Iqbal ki umrein dikhayi ja sakein, jo output ke hisse ke taur par print hoti hain.

Comments woh lines hain jo Python interpreter nahi chalata; yeh code ke baare mein wazahat ya notes dete hain. Ek line ka comment # se shuru hota hai, aur kai lines ka comment shuru aur aakhir mein triple quotes ke darmiyan likha ja sakta hai.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
# This is a single-line comment
print("K2 is the second-highest mountain in the world")
"""
This is a multi-line comment.
It can span multiple lines.
"""
print("Edhi Foundation operates the world's largest volunteer ambulance network.")

blocks.prompt: Python code mein comments ka maqsad samjhaiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: Comments batate hain ke code kya karta hai aur kyun, programmer aur baad mein parhne wale ke liye; Python program chalate waqt inhein nazar-andaz karti hai, to yeh rawayya nahi badalte.

blocks.prompt: Python mein variables ka tasawwur samjhaiye (long question 4).
blocks.explanation: Variable aisa naam hai jo memory mein rakhi qeemat ki taraf ishara karta hai; yeh assignment se banta hai (age = 17), is ki qeemat baad mein parhi aur badli ja sakti hai (age = 18), aur qeemat ki qism (int, float, str, bool) rakhi gayi cheez se tay hoti hai. Naam naming rules ke mutabiq aur ba-maani hone chahiyein.

items: Variable: naam wala dabba jis ki qeemat badal sakti hai (age = 71, phir 60).
Comments: ek line ke liye #, kai lines ke liye triple quotes; program chalte waqt nazar-andaz.
